QUOTE: With the opt-out: the same token becomes `ctx.nr`, the real field name. ... Default (opt-out not set): `ctx.MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` becomes `ctx.private_nr`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain names while default consumers see the private_-renamed members.
